name: com.firedragongamestudio.simplewebrtc
description:
Component-based Unity WebRTC wrapper for peer-to-peer audio, video, 360° video and data channels. Pluggable signaling: WebSocket (NativeWebSocket or Meta Voice SDK), Photon Fusion 2, in-process loopback or your own transport.

Requires WebRTC (FDGS) com.fdgs.webrtc 3.2.0+: https://github.com/FireDragonGameStudio/com.unity.webrtc.fdgs.git#v3.2.0

samples.description: WebSocket signaling samples: single client, client with lobby UI, three clients in one scene and a plain signaling connection test. Start the signaling server from Server~ (npm install && npm start) or set your own server URL.
Two peers in one scene connected with LoopbackSignaling: video, chat and connection stats without any signaling server.

How to plug your own signaling backend into SimpleWebRTC: UdpBroadcastSignaling finds peers in the local network via UDP broadcast, so the sample scene connects several instances (or devices in the same Wi-Fi) without any server. Also contains a minimal commented transport template.

Signaling over a Photon Fusion 2 session instead of a WebSocket server. Install Photon Fusion 2 before importing this sample and add the SimpleWebRTC.PhotonFusion assembly to NetworkProjectConfig > Assemblies To Weave.

Visual Scripting nodes, events and a sample graph. Install the Unity Visual Scripting package before importing this sample and regenerate the Visual Scripting nodes in the project settings afterwards.

Streams a 360° video (monoscopic or stereo over-under) rendered from a 3D scene, using CubemapVideoSource on the sender and RenderTextureVideoSink on the receiver. Streaming 360° video takes considerable rendering resources.
